text: Could you assist me while I collect one form from each team and return the borrowed key?
meaning: Ask a colleague to help gather forms from several teams and give a borrowed key back.
context: A worker gathers one fictional workshop form from each of three teams and gives a borrowed meeting-room key back to reception.

references.scope: Original workplace expression; wording, assessed senses, and usage await review.

The proposed form-from-each-team clause assesses gathering, not reception pickup. This source consultation does not independently approve the exact sentence, tokenization, focus binding, courtesy/register or context.
